biotools.summary: Free web application for bioassay data analysis that runs entirely in the browser. It fits ELISA standard curves (4PL, 5PL, linear, quadratic, log-log) with back-calculated recovery and quality checks, estimates IC50/EC50 from dose-response data with Z' factor, performs parallel line analysis for relative potency following Ph. Eur. 5.3 and USP <1032>/<1034>, reduces kinetic plate-reader data with group statistics (t-test, ANOVA, post-hoc and non-parametric tests), and computes ecotoxicological indices (EDI, THQ, HI, CR, CF, PLI, Igeo, BSAF, BAF, Fulton's K). No registration is required, data are processed locally on the user's device, and results can be exported as CSV or PDF reports.
